positions.commentary: The speaker expresses amazement at the level of rigor and experimentation Uber demonstrated at every little piece of the driver acquisition process.

thesis: This episode uses Uber as a singular case study to illustrate the immense talent and rigorous experimentation required for performance marketing, specifically regarding driver acquisition and connecting ad creatives to driving metrics. The speaker expresses amazement at the depth of testing and measuring across the entire customer funnel demonstrated by the company.

claims.claim: The speaker highlights Uber as a fascinating example of immense talent and rigor in testing, measuring, and experimenting across the entire customer funnel, specifically for driver acquisition.
claims.quote: We worked with Uber for a long time and did a lot of driver acquisition for them. And that was a fascinating one. It made me realize how much of our business was the bottom of the funnel in activation versus traditional marketing.

claims.claim: Uber is praised for its immense talent and rigor in testing and measuring every piece of the funnel, connecting driving metrics to specific ad creatives.
claims.quote: I think what they did that was really well was Uber because of the immense talent and rigor there. We talk about a long funnel and building an advantage in that. They would test and measure and every little piece of it.

claims.claim: The speaker expresses amazement at the level of rigor and experimentation Uber demonstrated at every little piece of the driver acquisition process.
claims.quote: And so I think the level of rigor and an experimentation at every little piece of that kind of blew our minds, right? We were able to connect things like, you know, amount of driving the person did or even amount of effective customer demand they drove because of incremental supply to the specific ad creatives that we were running.
